correctness.rationale: For nonzero variables valuation exponents 4a and 6b are either equal (a=3k,b=2k), separated by exactly 2 (near-ties a=3k+1 or a=3k+2), or separated by at least 4. Odd fourth powers equal 1+16Z_2 and odd sixth powers equal 1+8Z_2. Each case yields and exhausts the seven disjoint balls; constructive unit choices attain every point. The seven Haar masses sum exactly to (1073/4096)*1/(1-1/4096)=1073/4095. Direct independent full residue-set comparisons modulo 2^1 through 2^16 passed.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural local-solubility classification for the mixed even-power Diophantine map \(x^4+y^6\), with its exact 2-adic Haar density. The first nontrivial unequal even-power pair beyond squares has two competing valuations 4a and 6b, a 12-scale resonance and sharp 2-adic near-tie obstructions; the seven-coset result supplies a useful concrete benchmark for mixed-exponent congruence images. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or a claim of global integral representability.
